definitions.explanation: The act of formally acquiring or obtaining something such as a license, qualification, right, or property. Used in official, legal, and business contexts.

examples.japanese: {資格|しかく}を{取得|しゅとく}する。
{運転免許|うんてんめんきょ}を{取得|しゅとく}した。
{有給休暇|ゆうきゅうきゅうか}の{取得|しゅとく}{率|りつ}が{低|ひく}いのが{問題|もんだい}だ。
examples.english: The low rate of taking paid leave is a problem.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{資格|しかく}{取得|しゅとく} (obtaining a qualification)
・{免許|めんきょ}を{取得|しゅとく}する (acquire a license)
・{特許|とっきょ}を{取得|しゅとく}する (obtain a patent)
・{有給|ゆうきゅう}{取得|しゅとく} (taking paid leave)
・データを{取得|しゅとく}する (acquire/retrieve data)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{取|と}る is the everyday word for getting or taking something. {取得|しゅとく} is the formal, written equivalent used for official acquisitions — licenses, qualifications, rights, and properties. In IT contexts, {取得|しゅとく} is also used for retrieving or fetching data.
